summary: All 14 native images and full contact inspected at D300. Faces remain coherent without observed broad new collapse. Familiar skin-like white patches, ragged pale bands and right-neck pitting persist on training identities. The partial b2-051 rectangle does not resolve rough neck boundaries. Validation, new diagnostic heldouts and unseen images retain ordinary clothing; hats and extra-person fragments persist. No convincing generalization or production approval.
limits: Small fixed panel. Contact-level coherence does not establish native photographic quality, identity preservation or distributional diversity. Held-out cases remain excluded from training.
